summary: Backend-only testing of Thermal Casting LLP Phase 2 Enterprise Admin CMS. Executed 39 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_cms.py plus regression of all 26 Phase 1 cases — 65/65 PASSED (100%). Coverage: 4-role auth (super_admin/admin/sales_executive/customer), Materials CRUD (16 seeded, cascade $pull from products.material_ids on delete), Categories CRUD (10+ seeded), Extended Products (all Phase 2 fields incl. pressure_class/temperature_rating/casting_process/SEO), duplicate/toggle (featured|enabled|archived + 400 on invalid), Company profile CMS, News (announcement filter), Enhanced RFQ (sales_executive can set priority/quotation_url/quotation_amount/assigned_to), Customers (list+rfq_count, search, role/password_hash immutable), Staff (super_admin-only; admin blocked with 403; password hashed on PATCH & new login works; cannot delete self), AI Docs (list excludes content field, chat still succeeds after upload), Inquiries (INQ-2026-NNNNN, sales can update, history appended), Audit Logs (sales blocked, entries recorded with actor_email/actor_role/action/entity), CSV import/export (skip missing name/category, sales can export). Every mutation verified with follow-up GET for persistence.

minor.issue: ref_no uses count_documents()+1 (same race condition as RFQ). Under concurrent inserts, generated TC-NNNNN codes can collide. Recommend an atomic counters collection.
Same count-based ref_no pattern for INQ-2026-NNNNN — race-vulnerable but no functional blocker.
In-loop uses local base_count for ref_no assignment; safe within a single request but not atomic across concurrent imports.
Silently pops disallowed fields (role, password_hash, id). Consider returning 400 or a warning header so misuse is visible to clients.
history push uses payload.get('admin_note') — if the client sends 'admin_notes' (plural, matching the RFQ field name), the note is stored as 'updated'. Naming inconsistency vs RFQ 'admin_notes'.

action_items: Optional: replace count_documents()+1 ref_no generators (products, inquiries, RFQs, CSV import) with an atomic counters collection to avoid race collisions in production.
Optional: harmonize inquiry-history field name — use 'admin_notes' (matching RFQ) instead of 'admin_note' in PATCH /api/admin/inquiries/{id}.
Optional: server.py is now 1382 lines — well past the 700-line split threshold. Split into routers: auth, products, materials, categories, media, rfq, inquiries, ai, admin_cms, staff, audit, csv.
Optional: migrate deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown handlers to FastAPI lifespan context manager.
critical_code_review_comments: RBAC dependencies (require_admin / require_admin_or_super / require_super_admin) are correctly enforced across all Phase 2 endpoints — verified positive+negative cases for sales_executive vs admin vs super_admin.
Customer PATCH correctly pops role/password_hash/id before $set — verified by attempting to escalate role via PATCH (rejected silently, role remained 'customer').
Staff PATCH hashes 'password' field via passlib bcrypt before storing as 'password_hash' — verified by logging in with the new password after update.
AI docs list excludes 'content' field via projection {content: 0} — verified.
Material DELETE correctly cascades $pull to products.material_ids — verified with a live product referencing the deleted material.
product toggle endpoint correctly whitelists field ∈ {enabled, featured, archived} and returns 400 otherwise — verified.
audit_log helper writes actor_id/actor_email/actor_role/action/entity/entity_id/meta/timestamp for every mutating action — verified against material.create entry.
server.py has grown to 1382 lines (from 726 in iteration 1). This is now 2x the recommended split threshold and should be modularized into routers.
All Mongo reads still correctly project out _id. Good.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All test-created rows (materials, products, staff, news, inquiries, ai_docs, categories) were deleted in-test. Company tagline was mutated but is expected to be user-editable via the CMS.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base: https://casting-master-dna.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Four seeded accounts in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Phase 2 endpoints under /api/admin/{materials,categories,products/full,products/{id}/duplicate,products/{id}/toggle?field=,company,news,customers,staff,rfq,inquiries,ai/docs,audit-logs,products/import-csv,products/export-csv}. RBAC layers: require_admin=super_admin+admin+sales_executive, require_admin_or_super=super_admin+admin, require_super_admin=super_admin only. Ref-no formats: RFQ-YYYY-NNNNN, INQ-YYYY-NNNNN, TC-NNNNN (products). Company tagline is now user-mutable via PATCH /api/admin/company — do not hard-assert its value in future tests.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues found. Only cosmetic/architectural improvements noted (file-size split, atomic counters, field-name harmonization).
